basic_details.job_title: IPRCL Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 2 AGM-E6 / JGM-E5 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Indian Port Rail & Ropeway Corporation Ltd. (IPRCL), a company under the Ministry of Ports, Shipping & Waterways, Government of India, is filling 02 posts of AGM (Civil)-E6 / JGM (Civil)-E5 on absorption or on deputation under Vacancy Circular No. 09/2026 dated 04.11.2026. Applications in the prescribed format go by post, courier or by hand to the Chief General Manager (HR), IPRCL, Mumbai, and the last date for submission is 4 December 2026. Applications are invited from Indian citizens who are presently working in Railways, other Govt. departments, Central PSUs, Ports, JV Companies under Govt

Service conditions follow the Offer of Appointment, HR Policies of IPRCL and its orders from time to time. Three-month advance notice is required before resignation. content_sections.heading: About IPRCL
content_sections.text: Indian Port Rail & Ropeway Corporation Limited is a Joint Venture Company between 11 Major Ports under the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways, holding 90% of the equity, and Rail Vikas Nigam Limited under the Ministry of Railways, holding 10%. It was incorporated to provide efficient rail evacuation systems to Major Ports and to enhance their capacity and throughput, and was registered on 10th July 2015 as a Public Limited Company under the Companies Act, 2013. Its Corporate Office is at Mazgaon (E), Mumbai, and its Registered Office is at Lodhi Road, New Delhi.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Send the filled-in application, with the self-attested enclosures, to this address: Chief General Manager (HR), Indian Port Rail & Ropeway Corporation Ltd (IPRCL), 4th Floor, Nirman Bhavan, Mumbai Port Trust Building, M.P. Road, Mazgaon (E), Mumbai- 400010. Use the application form in Annexure-II if you are applying on absorption, or the format in Annexure-III if you are applying on deputation. Fill in every column; the notice says an application with a blank column may be rejected, and the particulars given will be treated as final. Attach the self-attested documents listed under Enclosures below. Write "Application for the post of ______" (with the post name) on the top of the envelope. Send it by post or courier, or drop it personally, so that it is submitted by 04.12.2026. If you are serving in Railways, other Govt. departments, Central PSUs, Ports or JV Companies under Govt. Control, submit the application through proper channel only. If you are eligible for both posts and want to apply for both, submit a separate application for each post. IPRCL will not be held responsible if a candidate cannot submit the application by the last date for whatever reason.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Send these self-attested documents with the application, and produce them (originals) if called for Personal Interview: Matriculation Certificate (for age proof). Certificates and Mark-sheets in support of the required educational/professional qualifications. Certificates in proof of experience, clearly indicating the length and field of experience. Copy of the appointment letter for the post currently held, with valid Identity card/Current Pay Slip issued by the company. Copies of last 5 years APARs/ACRs (not applicable to officers working in a Private Company). Latest updated detailed CV. Photo I.D. proof and address proof (Passport/Aadhaar Card/Driving License/PAN card/Voter Card) issued by Central/State Govt. 'No Objection Certificate' if working in Railways, other Govt. departments, Central PSUs, Ports or JV Companies under Govt. Control (not applicable to Private Company candidates). Copy of Audited balance sheet for proof of Sales Turnover (only for candidates working in a Private Company).

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is through a Personal Interview, which may be held at the Corporate Office of IPRCL, through V.C. or at any other location at IPRCL's discretion. Shortlisting: suitable candidates will be shortlisted on their eligibility/experience in the relevant field. Where there are 05 or more eligible candidates for each vacancy, IPRCL reserves the right to shortlist in the ratio of 1:5. Interview intimation: sent through e-mail/IPRCL website; candidates should keep checking the website rather than wait for e-mail. Document verification: original documents of qualifications, experience and age are checked at the interview. A candidate whose identity is in doubt, who cannot produce documents, whose information mismatches or who is found ineligible will not be allowed to appear, and the candidature will be cancelled. NOC: shortlisted candidates serving in Railways, Govt. departments, Central PSUs, Ports or JV Companies under Govt. Control must submit a No Objection Certificate from their employer at the interview. Travelling expenses: paid for appearing in the Personal Interview as per Company Policy.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IPRCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 02 posts of AGM (Civil)-E6 / JGM (Civil)-E5, with tentative postings of 01 at Visakhapatnam and 01 at Chennai or Kolkata.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for IPRCL AGM / JGM (Civil) applications?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of the application is 4 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for IPRCL AGM (Civil) and JGM (Civil)?
faq.answer: A full time Degree in Civil Engineering from a recognized University, with experience in Execution of Infrastructure Projects; the degree requirement does not apply to candidates applying on deputation.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: On absorption, up to 52 years for AGM (Civil) and up to 50 years for JGM (Civil); on deputation, up to 57 years, all as on 04.12.2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of IPRCL AGM (Civil) and JGM (Civil)?
faq.answer: On absorption, AGM (Civil) gets IDA Scale Rs. 90000-240000/- and JGM (Civil) gets Rs. 80000-220000/-, each plus applicable allowances and PRP; deputationists get parent pay plus Deputation Duty Allowance.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for IPRCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill Annexure-II (absorption) or Annexure-III (deputation), attach self-attested enclosures, and send it by post, courier or by hand to the Chief General Manager (HR), IPRCL, 4th Floor, Nirman Bhavan, Mumbai Port Trust Building, M.P. Road, Mazgaon (E), Mumbai- 400010.

faq.question: Q7. What is written on the envelope?
faq.answer: The envelope must be superscribed "Application for the post of ______" with the post applied for.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Selection is by Personal Interview after shortlisting on eligibility and experience, in the ratio 1:5 when there are 05 or more eligible candidates per vacancy.

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply for both AGM (Civil) and JGM (Civil)?
faq.answer: Yes, a candidate eligible for both posts must submit a separate application for each post.

faq.question: Q10. Is a No Objection Certificate required?
faq.answer: Candidates serving in Railways, Govt. departments, Central PSUs, Ports or JV Companies under Govt. Control must apply through proper channel and submit an NOC at the Personal Interview if shortlisted; it is not required from Private Company candidates.
